plan.title: ECC outcome parity and native AQ-OS integration
plan.goal: Use pinned ECC evidence to implement only genuine missing outcomes through existing AQ-OS authorities, with measurable QA, dashboard visibility, and secure activation boundaries.
success_criteria: Every selected outcome has pinned upstream and local evidence with an explicit parity verdict
No bulk agent/skill import or competing lifecycle authority is introduced
Each implementation slice ships tests, integration-path aq-qa coverage, dashboard visibility, documentation and independent acceptance
External code, tools and deployments remain disabled until their separate intake and owner-authority gates pass

phases.goal: evidence-backed outcome coverage and gap resolver

items.name: corrected parity evidence and coordinator contract
items.goal: pin ECC, correct advisory claims, produce provenance-complete artifact ledger, PRD, meta-prompt and bounded plan

acceptance.note: Independent PLAN_READY and commit-bound PASS on the pre-tracker subject; tracker added from Tier-0 governance warning and requires final rebind before commit.
